description: Create a new Drop Spot client document intake request (dossier). Generates a zero-password magic upload link and optionally emails the client.

clientEmail.description: Email address of the client where the magic link will be sent

clientName.description: Full name of the client (e.g. "Jane Doe")

clientPhone.description: Optional phone number for SMS reminders

dueAt.description: ISO 8601 deadline date (optional, defaults to 14 days from now)

items.description: Checklist of items and documents required from the client

allowMultiple.description: Allow uploading multiple files for this item

isRequired.description: Whether this item is mandatory (default: true)

sendInvitationEmail.description: Whether to automatically email the client the invitation link (defaults to true)

title.description: Title of the intake request (e.g. "2026 Tax Return Documentation")

name: create_intake_request
